text:
sasha: embedding service in eu-west1 spiking memory/GC since 01:12 UTC, error rate ~5%. suspect kvcache fragmentation. want to do an emergency hotfix + controlled failover to us-central for traffic-sensitive tenants during the 01:30-02:00 UTC window.
deploy-bot: New deploy request DR-2030-010 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.3.0-hotfix. plan: 5% canary in us-central -> 30% -> 100% OR traffic split by tenant for high-priority clients.
mike: can we avoid full region cut? prefer tenant-based split first. need infra lead expedited approval to bypass standard 15m canary for critical tenants.
sasha: proposing expedited cadence: 5% for 4m, 30% for 6m, then ramp. rollback pinned to v3.2.5 immediately on alerts.
oliver: i'll approve expedited path if we add instant rollback hook and a 20m post-deploy monitoring hold. tagging ops-bot to create alerts.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-8123 created: embeddings-us-central p95 > 220ms OR errors > 1% OR any OOM. Escalation: oncall -> infra-lead.
sasha: runbook snippet:
```
# start tenant-scoped canary in us-central
deployctl rollout --cluster us-central --svc embeddings --image v3.3.0-hotfix --filter tenants=priority --percent 5 --note "hotfix-DR-2030-010"
# immediate rollback
deployctl rollback --cluster us-central --svc embeddings --image v3.2.5
```
mike: please also pin the old image on eu-west1 pool and expose a switch to cut traffic back instantly. ops-bot add temp route flag.
ops-bot: Temp route flag created: route.override=eu-west1-pin-v3.2.5.
releasebot: release note draft attached to DR-2030-010: "Embeddings v3.3.0-hotfix — fix kvcache fragmentation causing GC/OOMs for long-prefix reuse; no change to model outputs." Link: https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2030-010
noliver: Approved (DM). Conditions: pinned fallback, rollback shortcut, 20m post-deploy observability hold. sasha/mike own monitoring.
sasha: ops-bot start scheduled deploy at 01:30 UTC. Operators: sasha, mike, oliver.
ops-bot: Scheduled: DR-2030-010 will start 01:30 UTC.
mike: final checklist: canary health, kv cache hit ratio, heap fragmentation, traces. if any OOM/segfault, rollback immediately.
sasha: posting release note to #release-notes once deploy starts. will update thread with outcome. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
